text:
leo: CI is red on feature/fast-serve after I ran a lockfile regen. wheel build failing on manylinux step, looks like pybind11-related binary tag mismatch.

sasha: ugh. can you paste the failing log?

leo: here — main error chunk:
```
Building wheel for pybind11 (pyproject.toml) ... error
ERROR: Failed building wheel for pybind11
Running setup.py clean for pybind11
Failed to build pybind11
ERROR: Could not build wheels for pybind11 which use PEP 517 and cannot be installed directly
wheel build for project_name: manylinux2014_x86_64 tag expected but got linux_x86_64
```

anya: did the lock regen change any build-system deps (setuptools, wheel, pip)? sometimes a pip bump changes tag handling.

leo: lock diff shows pip 23.2 -> 24.1 and wheel 0.40 -> 0.41 in the transitive graph. also pybind11 pinned -> 2.11.0 (was 2.10.1).

mike: @leo can you run `pip wheel --no-binary :all: pybind11` locally inside our docker image? might reproduce faster than full CI.

leo: ran that; same platform tag mismatch locally in manylinux container. suspect the wheel package/version combo changed default tag creation.

devops-bot: <CI job failed: https://ci.example.com/redwood/fast-serve/3472> (job: wheel-build-manylinux)

anya: if it's a pip/wheel regression we can either: 1) revert the lock regen, 2) add a temporary patch to pin wheel/pip to previous working versions in constraints, or 3) patch our build image to normalize tags. option 2 is fastest for prod unblock.

leo: leaning 2. opened a small PR to force wheel==0.40.0 in dev/constraints.txt — but want a second review before merging. PR: https://git.example.com/r/redwood/fast-serve/-/merge_requests/512

mike: quick bisect idea — can we reproduce by checking out the lockfile before/after and attempting the manylinux build? if it's just wheel, the bisect might be two commits (pip/wheel). if someone wants to run:
```bash
git checkout <old-lock>
docker build -t test-manylinux .
docker run --rm test-manylinux bash -lc "pip install -U pip wheel && pip wheel --no-binary :all: pybind11"
```

sasha: @leo if you want me to run the bisect I can do it, small window today. otherwise go ahead and merge the constraint PR and we can escalate if it reappears.

leo: thanks — will wait 15m for any objections, then merge constraint PR. will also add a short note in the PR about follow-up: open an infra ticket to investigate pip/wheel tag change and whether our manylinux image needs updating.

ci-bot: rerun job triggered by leo (user). queued: wheel-build-manylinux #3472-retry

anya: heads-up: if this surfaces for customers on Dedicated, we'll need a patch release path. good to have the follow-up infra ticket. :+1:

leo: merged constraint PR. I'll monitor the rerun. thanks all.

devops-bot: <CI job passed: https://ci.example.com/redwood/fast-serve/3472> (job: wheel-build-manylinux)

leo: green now. filing infra ticket for deeper root-cause investigation and adding test to verify wheel tag expectations during lock updates.

sasha: nice. short-term fix worked. remember to link the bisect notes in the ticket.

leo: will do.
